Features

  • Unfold more possibilities

    Whatever shape your life takes, we’ve got a foldable that fits. After years of crafting and perfecting, our latest is our greatest, offering you three unique options to unfold more productivity, more discovery and more fun.

  • Split the view. Multitask to the max

    Productivity never felt this powerful. Stay one step ahead with AI² that suggests which apps you might need next. Then view those multiple windows¹ side by side on the large screen of Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra.

  • Any shot, all the details

    Dive into the details of any shot with our best camera system on a foldable. Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra boasts a 200MP camera —and now also features an upgraded 50MP Ultra Wide lens —letting you shoot stunning wide shots and extreme close-ups all from the same device.

  • The battery you’ve been waiting for

    It’s the battery you’ve been wanting in a foldable. Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra packs a powerful ultra-sized³ battery in an ultra-slim design. Plus, with Super Fast Charging 2.0⁴ charge up faster than ever before and get back to living your life.

  • Powerful performance that’s a real flex

    Experience what’s possible with our most advanced processor yet on Galaxy Z Series. From immersive gaming and speedy multitasking to using the latest Galaxy AI⁵ features, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy works behind the scenes to keep everything running seamlessly.

  • Lock in to the moment

    Bring on the bumps, jumps and chaos. Super Steady Video with Horizontal Lock⁶ keeps your footage perfectly upright for smooth, level footage every time.

  • The brightest display on a Galaxy phone

    Our brightest smartphone display⁷ provides you with a comfortable view, whether you’re inside or outside. Watch movies, game and scroll with ease no matter where you are.

  • Big screen. Sweeter victories.

    Unfold the perfect view with a big display for big gaming. Close in on enemies crawling in the grass or find hidden images in puzzles with a bright, massive screen

  • Easily open and expand your potential

    Unfold a whole new dimension of productivity. Effortlessly open Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra and watch as it transforms from a premium bar phone into an expansive tablet-like experience built to maximize your multitasking.

  • Moving to Galaxy is now easier than ever

    Samsung makes moving to Galaxy simple. Bring over the things you expect - like photos and contacts. And the things you don't - like alarms, passwords and eSIMs. Plus, you'll be able to share files and encrypt messages in the same manner you're used to.⁸
